description: EU public procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), filtered by buyer country (ISO 3-letter code) and publication date within the last 1 to 90 days. Returns number, date, notice type, title, buyer and PDF link. Search covers published notices only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
